# Family Dental Centre

> Family Dental Centre is a multi-location dental practice in Singapore offering comprehensive general, restorative, cosmetic, and orthodontic dental services with MediSave-claimable options.

Family Dental Centre operates multiple clinics across Singapore including locations in Balestier, Harbour Point, Taman Jurong, and other areas. The practice specializes in patient-centered care with appointment booking, sedation dentistry for anxious patients, and pediatric services, alongside advanced treatments like dental implants, clear aligners, and cosmetic procedures.
